$comment: The default prioritization scoring setup: what GET /projects/prioritization answers when no setup is stored (config_version 0). The backend copy is DEFAULT_AXES in lambda/shared/prioritization_axes.py (schemas/ is not bundled into Lambdas); test_prioritization_default_axes_lockstep.py pins the two. The frontend imports this file as its offline default. Each axis is scored 1-5 (0 = not scored); weights are relative integers 0-100, the composite normalises over their sum. See docs/prioritization.md.
